name: boot_to_title
description: Boot with no input; capture the shared 'DIDDY KONG RACING' title-logo screen in both runners. This is the sync/validation anchor: both the real ROM (ares) and the native port render the identical static logo early in boot (native ~f40-140, ares ~f80-220), before their boot paths diverge (the native port blanks the N64-logo/Diddy intro that the real ROM plays). Proves the harness captures comparable frames from both.
